score_contract.luminance: Integer floor (299R+587G+114B)/1000; int32 original arithmetic. Ignore source alpha for luminance itself.
score_contract.opacity: A>128, strictly. Hidden RGB at A0/A128 remains in source RGBA hash but never contributes to opacity/edges/dark/light/flat.
score_contract.extent: Original computes H=floor(h/8)*8,W=floor(w/8)*8 then crops lum/op. Successful six-counter domain is positive dimensions>=8 and both multiples8; smaller/odd cases have the bugs documented below.
score_contract.strong_edges: Horizontal neighboring luminance absolute difference>90 and BOTH opaque. Append one false column at image right. An edge across two8px tiles belongs to the tile containing its left pixel. No vertical edge test.
score_contract.tile_statistics: For every8x8tile, edge count et; opaque fraction ot; dark fraction dk=(lum<90 AND opaque)/64; light fraction lt=(lum>150 AND opaque)/64. Strict boundaries matter.
score_contract.glyph_tile: et>=6 AND dk>.05 AND dk<.7 AND lt>.15 AND ot>.5.
score_contract.cluster: Glyph tile whose inclusive3x3 neighborhood has>=3glyph tiles. Self counts, so two OTHER glyph tiles suffice; diagonal neighbors count. Out-of-image neighbors are false. Cluster fraction=cluster count/max(1,count of ALL tiles with ot>.5), not divided by glyph count.
score_contract.text_line_rows: For each tile row, find longest consecutive run of glyph tiles. Count row if run>=8. Gaps reset run; clusters are not used for this statistic.
score_contract.flat_fraction: On successful domain, select ORIGINAL RGB at opaque mask; quantize each channel by floor(/8), key=(R//8)*1024+(G//8)*32+(B//8). Max bucket count/total opaque pixels, or0 if no opaque pixels. Do not use exact RGBA uniqueness, palette indices or all pixels.
score_contract.opaque_fraction: Mean of cropped opacity mask. Fractions are IEEE float64 division results; do not round to percentages or tolerance buckets.

source_bugs_and_deliberate_dispositions.case: Positive width/height>=8 but either not multiple8
source_bugs_and_deliberate_dispositions.original: op is cropped, but flat indexes a[...,:3] without cropping a. Boolean mask dimensions differ, so NumPy raises IndexError. _score_safe returns[-1,0,0,0,0,0]. Odd9x8,8x9,17x17 are frozen with exact error messages. Earlier tile computations are not a successful complete score.
source_bugs_and_deliberate_dispositions.new_contract: Decoded geometry and exact RGBA hash remain valid. Scores null/unavailable with diagnostic; keep path tier and name-hint/ui-folder reasons based on decoded pixels. This is deliberate source-bug handling, not successful cropped6counter parity.

source_bugs_and_deliberate_dispositions.original: Early score return is three fields[0,0,0]. _score_safe preserves this malformed tuple; later cmd_csv and cmd_sheets index d[5] and can fail, even before tier guard because evaluation order reads d[5] first.
source_bugs_and_deliberate_dispositions.new_contract: Scores null/unavailable with diagnostic. Never fabricate six zero counters or call it original parity. Decoded pixels still permit path/name reasons.
Undecoded pixels have no score and no flag reasons, even when path/hint matches. Preserve explicit diagnostic/error status and any raw source identity.

classification_contract.tier: entry.lower() followed by original anchored MODEL regex first, ICONS second, otherwise ui. Backslashes are literal separators. Forward slashes are not silently normalized. Regex branches are prefixes, not semantic directory validation; preserve their actual boundary behavior.
classification_contract.HINT: Unanchored search in entry + space + native texture name, original re.I pattern: help|tut|rule|setumei|guide|illust|title|logo|news|kojityu|mini_|card_|casino|prize|sale|button|panel|ready|start|gameset|survive|wanted|jikai|food_t|f_title|op_p|win_. No OCR or screen-context proof.
ordered_reasons: Decoded pixels AND tier ui/icons => ui-folder.
Decoded pixels AND measured text_line_rows>=1 AND model => detector-text-lines.
Decoded pixels AND measured clusters>=40 AND dominant_color_fraction>=.3 AND ui => detector-glyphs.
Decoded pixels AND HINT(entry + space + texture) => name-hint.
classification_contract.flagged: bool ordered reasons nonempty; original CSV serializes int0/1 and joins reasons with+. New structured bool/list is a new report shape, not CSV byte parity.
classification_contract.Unicode_gotchas: Python re.I matchesASCIIkeywords against İ/ı,ſ,K variants. Python entry.lower expands U0130 to i+combiningdot, so textures\WİN_MON is ui rather than icons; raw HINT still matches win_. A Go lowercaser that drops the combining dot changes tier. Frozen primary24branch cases plus25real-PNG cases bind this distinction.
classification_contract.unknown_scores: Decoded unmeasurable image may have ui-folder/name-hint reasons while statistical reasons remain unavailable. Nil/undecodable image has zero reasons. Tier remains path-derived advisory metadata.

batch_manifest_contract.source: Extracted regular CMB, streamed through ReaderAt+full source hashes/rechecks; no ISO fallback. Reuse existing cmbIndex bounds/name/overlap/indexSHA authority, enhanced to retain original index ordinal order.
batch_manifest_contract.ordering: Original CMB index order first, native dictionary order within entry. Never sort rows by physical member payload offsets, map iteration or filename. Stable annotation IDs remain links, not a replacement for source order.
batch_manifest_contract.entry_accounting: Every selected CMB entry has a record, including raw PNG, valid multi-native TXD, malformed TXD, empty dictionary, nontexture, duplicate native names and local metadata errors. PNG signature is checked before TXD parsing. Report member source spans/length/hash, native ordinal/name/raw header, real decode or error/unknown, output preview links/hashes, decoded RGBA hash, annotation links, discovery facts and diagnostics separately.
batch_manifest_contract.codec_authority: indexTextures and texture remain sole native parser/codec. Duplicate native names remain in index but exact selector decode must not choose one; both rows unknown with ambiguity diagnostics. One unsupported/local-metadata-error native must not erase a valid sibling. No old guessed linear PSMCT32, no first-native fallback.
batch_manifest_contract.source_vs_pixels: Raw member SHA and output PNG SHA differ from decoded raw RGBA SHA. A valid decoded odd PNG has true9x8geometry/RGBA SHA but unavailable detector scores. Empty/nontexture/error does not invent pixel dimensions or successful flags.
batch_manifest_contract.publication: Root selected one deterministic ZIP of previews+manifest, exclusive writeNewFile and dry-run no output. No overwrites or partial directory. Source/profile identity checks precede publish; archive labels are declared provenance, not a verified ISO location.
batch_manifest_contract.resource_decision: Root bounds: source<=1GiB streamed;<=100000CMB records, existing64MiB per-native input/1Mpx raster guards, total attempt/work budget2^28, ZIP<=128MiB. Budget rows must remain explicit unavailable/unknown, never silently truncate source accounting. This study does not measure real910MB BATTLE or claim full-corpus throughput.
